title: Food, Glorious Food
intro: [excited] Welcome in, and I hope you came HUNGRY! Today's board is an all-you-can-eat buffet of Disney food: rat chefs, famous feasts, park snacks and some very tasty rhymes. Napkins ready? [chuckles] Let's dig in.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A lavish banquet table overflowing with pastries, fruit, steaming pots, beignets dusted with powdered sugar and a towering cake, under twinkling chandeliers in a storybook dining hall.

categories.title: Anyone Can Cook
categories.intro: Our film category is Ratatouille! Pixar's tastiest movie... served with a side of Paris. [chuckles]

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A busy Parisian restaurant kitchen at night, copper pots hanging, a bubbling pot of vegetable stew, a tiny chef's hat on the counter, the Eiffel Tower glowing through the window.

clues.clue: Remy, the little chef with a big nose for flavor, is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a rat! [sarcastic] Not a mouse. Mickey would like you to know there's a difference.

clues.clue: This famous chef, whose cookbook Remy treasures, has the motto Anyone Can Cook.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Auguste Gusteau! He believed anyone can cook. He just didn't specify anyone could be a rodent.

clues.clue: This gloomy food critic's bad review cost Gusteau's restaurant a star.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Anton Ego! [laughs] His office is shaped like a coffin and his typewriter like a skull. Fun guy at parties.

clues.clue: Remy's hungry big brother, who will eat just about anything, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Emile! Django is their dad. Emile will eat garbage happily, while Remy only wants the finest cheese. Every family has one.

clues.clue: The fancy ratatouille Remy serves Ego was designed with help from this famous chef of The French Laundry.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Thomas Keller! His version is called confit byaldi, thin layered slices of vegetables. Fancy!

categories.title: Pass the Plate
categories.intro: Next up, Pass the Plate! It's all about famous food that shows up in Disney films.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A rustic wooden table with a shiny red apple, a plate of spaghetti, a pile of fried doughnut pillows dusted in sugar and a crate of eggs, warm candlelight.

clues.clue: Snow White takes one bite of this poisoned fruit and falls into a deep sleep.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an apple! [whispers] One bite and she's out. Moral of the story: never take snacks from strangers.

clues.clue: In The Lion King, Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba to eat these slimy yet satisfying snacks.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is bugs! [laughs] Slimy, yet satisfying. Some of them even taste like chicken, supposedly.

clues.clue: Tiana's famous powdered-sugar-topped fried treats, which Charlotte orders by the dozen.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is beignets! Charlotte calls them man-catching beignets. Results may vary.

clues.clue: Now that he's grown, Gaston brags that he eats this many eggs every morning.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is five dozen! As a lad it was only four dozen. That's sixty eggs a day, which explains a lot about Gaston.

clues.clue: In The Little Mermaid, this song is sung by Chef Louis as he chases Sebastian around the kitchen.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Les Poissons! [laughs] Hee hee hee, haw haw haw. Sebastian has never run faster in his life.

categories.title: Emoji Eats
categories.intro: Time for Emoji Eats! I'll show you some emoji and a hint. Name the Disney film or short. Mmm, delicious.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Playful oversized glossy 3D food icons floating in a bright pastel sky: a honey pot, a bowl of noodles, a teacup, a candy swirl and a steamed dumpling.

clues.clue: 🍯🐻🎈 Hint: a silly old bear with a rumbly tummy.
accept: the many adventures of winnie the pooh
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Winnie the Pooh! Think, think, think about honey.

clues.clue: 🍝🐕🐕🌙 Hint: a very famous noodle kiss.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lady and the Tramp! [sighs] One strand of spaghetti, one romantic meatball, and a whole lot of Bella Notte.

clues.clue: ☕🎩🐰⏰🎂 Hint: a very merry unbirthday to you.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alice in Wonderland! The Mad Hatter's tea party, where it is always six o'clock and always tea time.

clues.clue: 🍭🍩🏎️👧 Hint: a glitchy racer in a candy kart game.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Wreck-It Ralph! Vanellope von Schweetz races in Sugar Rush, a game made entirely of sweets.

clues.clue: 🥟👩‍👦❤️ Hint: an Oscar-winning Pixar short about a mom and a dumpling.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bao! [chuckles] It won the Oscar for best animated short. Bring tissues, and maybe some dumplings.

categories.title: Snack Attack
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category: Snack Attack! [whispers] Fair warning, you WILL be hungry after this one.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny theme park snack cart scene with swirled pineapple soft-serve, a giant smoked drumstick, frozen treats and a striped awning, palm trees in the background.

clues.clue: The classic chocolate-dipped Disney Parks ice cream bar is shaped like the head of this famous character.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey Mouse! [whispers] Pro tip: eat the ears first, before the Florida sun does.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Close-up of a chocolate-dipped vanilla ice cream bar shaped like a round head with two round ears, on a stick, held up against a sunny theme park street.

clues.clue: This pineapple soft-serve, sold near the Enchanted Tiki Room, is a legendary park treat.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dole Whip! [laughs] Cold, sweet and pineapple-y. The birds in the Tiki Room sing about it. Okay, not really.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A swirl of bright yellow pineapple soft-serve in a cup with a pineapple wedge, tropical palm fronds and bamboo tiki-style decor behind it.

clues.clue: This giant smoked drumstick is one of the biggest snacks you can carry around the parks.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the turkey leg! [chuckles] It's so big you could share it, but nobody ever does.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A giant glistening smoked turkey drumstick wrapped in paper, held up in front of a rustic western-style wooden snack stand.

clues.clue: The Grey Stuff, praised in Be Our Guest, can be tasted at this Magic Kingdom restaurant inside the Beast's castle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Be Our Guest Restaurant! [sings] Try the grey stuff. It's delicious. Don't believe me? Ask the dishes.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A small round grey whipped cream dessert piped on a cookie, served on an elegant plate in a grand ballroom-style dining hall with chandeliers.

clues.clue: This Disneyland spot in New Orleans Square serves Mickey-shaped beignets and non-alcoholic mint juleps.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Mint Julep Bar! The juleps are bright green and alcohol-free. Powdered sugar on your shirt is included.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Three-circle shaped beignets piled high and dusted with powdered sugar beside a frosty bright green mint drink, wrought-iron balcony of a New Orleans style courtyard.

categories.title: Rhyme Thyme
categories.intro: And the fan category: Rhyme Thyme! I'll give you two clues. One is a Disney character, the other is food. [chuckles] Combine them into a rhyme.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A whimsical spice rack where little jars of herbs, a sprig of thyme and rhyming food items like salsa and waffles dance across a checkered kitchen counter.

clues.clue: The Snow Queen of Arendelle plus a spicy tomato dip.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elsa Salsa! [laughs] It's chilled, of course. Let it go, let it dip.

clues.clue: Aladdin's villain plus a chocolate treat in a wrapper.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jafar Candy Bar! [mischievously] Sweet on the outside, evil on the inside.

clues.clue: The Jungle Book's happy-go-lucky bear plus a pot of melted cheese.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Baloo Fondue! The bare necessities: bread, cheese and a long fork.

clues.clue: Beast's candelabra friend plus a cream-filled French pastry.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lumiere Eclair! [excited] He'd flambé it himself. Ooh la la.

clues.clue: Cinderella's chubby mouse friend plus a tiny North African grain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gus Gus Couscous! [chuckles] A mouse who loves grains, served with a grain. Gus Gus would eat the whole bowl.
